title: A fixed pattern is not reordered by the locale

source.quote: The third optional argument specifies the locale identifier
source.supports: the example shows FORMAT( dt"2020-12-15T12:30:59", "mm/dd/yyyy", "en-GB" ) as 12/15/2020

source.quote: Because a non-locale dependent format string is specified, the locale is not applied and the non-locale format is returned.

derivation: DAX Guide shows 12/15/2020 for this formula and Microsoft Learn explains that the month stays first. Microsoft Learn prints the result as "12/15/2020 12:30:59", which cannot come from a format string with no time part.
alternative: Microsoft Learn lists the result of this formula as "12/15/2020 12:30:59".
